name: Berry smoothie bowl
summary: Frozen berries and banana blended thick with yoghurt into a spoonable bowl, topped with fresh banana, crunchy seeds and a spoon of peanut butter.
about: Smoothie bowls grew out of Brazil's açaí bowls: a smoothie blended thick enough to eat with a spoon, so it can carry crunchy toppings. Frozen berries and banana make the base cold and thick without ice or added sugar, and the bowls are on the table in ten minutes on a school morning.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.note: plus a little more if needed

steps: Let the frozen berries and banana stand for 5 minutes so the blender can grip them.

Put the yoghurt and milk in the blender first, then the frozen fruit. Blend on low, stopping to push the fruit down with a spatula every 20 seconds, for 1 to 2 minutes, until smooth and as thick as soft-serve ice cream. Add more milk only a tablespoon at a time if the blades stall.
Spoon into 2 bowls and top straight away with the sliced banana, the seeds and a spoon of peanut butter each, while the base is still thick and cold.
prepNote: Slice and freeze the banana in a bag the night before; frozen chunks keep 2 months.
